about: Obtain a variety of weapons and armor, including curiosities from a forgotten era with the Deluxe Edition.
You’ll receive cosmetic weapon and armor sets for the Warrior, Mage, and Rogue classes as well as cosmetic armor sets and weapons for each of your 7 companions.
That’s 3 armor sets for Rook, 6 weapons for Rook, 7 companion armor sets, and 7 companion weapons – saving Thedas never looked so good.
• 6 Weapon Appearances For Rook. Cosmetic Only.
• 1 Warrior Armor Set Appearance For Rook. Cosmetic Only.
• 1 Mage Armor Set Appearance For Rook. Cosmetic Only.
summary: Unite the Veilguard and defy the gods.
